test_altclip_vision_model: test the AltCLIPVisionModelTester to create and verify vision model outputs with pixel values
test_altclip_text_model: test the AltCLIPTextModelTester to create and verify text model outputs with input IDs
test_altclip_model: test the AltCLIPModelTester to verify the full multimodal model with text and image inputs
